metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use precipitation data for Washington D.C. in 2018 - Best dataset: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) or GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) - Date range: 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31 - Location: Washington D.C. (~38.9°N, -77.0°W) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products - These are processed rainfall estimates, not optical imagery 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: A dry location could legitimately have 0 rainfall (but unlikely for DC) - C1: If no images in collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid value - A/B: Compare total rainfall to 50 inches threshold (convert mm to inches: divide by 25.4) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dc = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]); const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dc); const colSize = await precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Number of images in collection: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data found for 2018.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all daily precipitation const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // 4. Check pixel count const countResult = await totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dc, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = countResult.precipitation; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate total precipitation const precipResult = await totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dc, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const totalMm = precipResult.precipitation; // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (totalMm === null || totalMm === undefined || isNaN(totalMm)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const totalInches = totalMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall in 2018: ${totalMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${totalInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Images used: ${colSize}`); if (totalInches >= 50) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
